summary: Military aircraft must avoid an equestrian event within 2 nautical miles of Taunton Racecourse, Shoreditch, up to 2000 ft above ground.
text:
MIL ACFT SHALL AVOID AN EQUESTRIAN EVENT WI 2NM RADIUS OF PSN 
505926N 0030456W (TAUNTON RACECOURSE, SHOREDITCH) LOW FLYING AREA 2.
SFC TO 2000FT AGL. EVENT CTC 01823 337172. 26/11/152/LFC
